name: Sheathalis
look: a wooden knife block with four black riveted handles sticking out of its slanted top and a teal pupa face with big orange eyes peeking out of the front
entry: Its cocoon hardens into something like a block of wood with knife handles sticking out of it. The blades inside are its new wings growing, and it peeks out of the front to keep watch.
how: Wild: uncommon by rivers and in plains.
